lvm_daemon_path.description: Absolute path to the LVM2 system daemon binary (lvm)

enable_monitoring.description: Whether to enable real-time monitoring of LVM events via D-Bus

max_pending_calls.description: Maximum number of pending D-Bus method calls before blocking new requests

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of LVM operations that can be queued

operation_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which an LVM operation is considered failed

monitored_vgs.description: List of volume group names to monitor via D-Bus (if empty, all VGs are monitored)

items.description: Name of a volume group to monitor

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Valid values: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL

log_file.description: Path to a file where logs are written (empty string to log only to stderr)

syslog_enabled.description: Whether to send log messages to the system logger (syslog)

dbus_service_name.description: D-Bus service name used by the LVM daemon

dbus_object_path.description: D-Bus object path for the main LVM manager interface
